# Marian Cozma — mcozma

> Product Design Lead. Shaping products, from direction to delivery.

Marian connects strategy, hands-on design and engineering. His public portfolio covers selected work, design leadership, mentorship and independent projects.

## Public portfolio

- [Marian Cozma — Product Design Lead](https://mcozma.com/): Marian Cozma connects strategy, hands-on design and engineering to shape products from direction to delivery. Explore his work, leadership and independent projects.
- [Product Design Portfolio — Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/work.html): Explore Marian Cozma’s design work for Google, Three, UBS, Legal & General and more, across technology, financial services and digital commerce.
- [About Marian Cozma — Design Leadership & Experience](https://mcozma.com/about.html): From engineering to product design leadership: explore Marian Cozma’s experience, design process, mentorship and the books that shape his thinking.
- [Lab — Independent Projects by Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/lab.html): Explore Decised, AVENTROPY and Wider Insights: Marian Cozma’s independent projects connecting curiosity, research, product design and delivery.
- [Contact Marian Cozma — Product Design & Collaboration](https://mcozma.com/contact.html): Talk with Marian Cozma about a product design opportunity, a client project through AVENTROPY or a new challenge. Book a conversation or get in touch by email.
- [Google — Component Systems & Interaction Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-google.html): A preview of Marian Cozma’s work on configurable components and interaction rules at Google, developed with product and engineering through design delivery.
- [Three UK — Connected Digital Experiences | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-three.html): Explore Marian Cozma’s contribution to customer journeys and reusable page structures at Three UK, connecting research, responsive design and platform delivery.
- [UBS — Research & Workflow Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-ubs.html): A preview of Marian Cozma’s research, workflow design and user testing for an operational platform at UBS, helping people understand priorities and act.
- [Legal & General — Responsive Content Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-legal-and-general.html): Explore Marian Cozma’s reusable content-tile design for Legal & General, connecting account tasks, customer control, responsive components and validation.
- [JLR — Range Rover Digital Sales Concept | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-jlr.html): Explore Marian Cozma’s contribution at Tangity to a Range Rover digital sales concept, connecting research, stakeholder workshops and experience design.
- [Totaljobs — Recruiter Commerce Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-totaljobs.html): A preview of Marian Cozma’s interface design and hands-on front-end implementation for responsive recruiter commerce at Totaljobs.
- [Virgin Media — Guided Support Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-virgin-media.html): Explore Marian Cozma’s work on guided support at Virgin Media, connecting content, navigation and decision logic across web and mobile experiences.
- [Design Mentorship — Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/mentorship.html): Practical design mentorship with Marian Cozma. Bring a portfolio, career question or live design challenge to a focused conversation.
